_doc: GATE 1 (DATA) reference list for the shadow-fleet signal (research/open_questions.md 'SHADOW-FLEET SIGNAL'): publicly documented sanctioned vessels, keyed by MMSI so they can be joined against our own AIS archive's gap/loiter detections (server/shadowFleet.ts).
